facts.fact: On 5 December 2025 the mayor of Addis Ababa launched the Integrated Civil Registration and Residency Service Technology, a platform integrating vital events registration with residency identification, and announced that full implementation would begin in 50 woredas on 8 December 2025 (Ethiopian News Agency).
facts.system: Integrated Civil Registration and Residency Service Technology

facts.fact: The mayor of Addis Ababa announced that full implementation of the Integrated Civil Registration and Residency Service Technology would commence in 50 woredas from 8 December 2025; this is an announced start, the report gives no total number of woredas, and it concerns the capital only.
facts.system: Integrated Civil Registration and Residency Service Technology

facts.fact: The platform was developed by the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute, a state body, and is for the Addis Ababa Civil Registration and Residency Service Agency, whose director general spoke for it at the launch on 5 December 2025; no vendor or donor is named.
facts.system: Integrated Civil Registration and Residency Service Technology
